candidate_signal_definition: Post-hoc heuristic detector over final RESPONSE messages from different agents. It flags low semantic similarity while both outputs remain task-relevant; it is not a preregistered inter-S1 disturbance or attenuation treatment.
matched_surface_strengths: same task corpus across compared framework runners
same benchmark evaluator and failure-detector stack
direct_s2_gate_failures: the benchmark does not define an explicit interaction-generated S2 disturbance whose attenuation is measured through a native coordination relation
conflicting_outputs is a post-hoc heuristic signal, not a treatment/control measure of disturbance attenuation
framework runners instantiate benchmark-authored organizations rather than holding one organizational relation constant across native S2 paths
only one compared canonical system has S2=A in the current Index cohort

frameworks.runner_organization: benchmark configures AutoGen GroupChat + GroupChatManager with round_robin speaker selection
frameworks.blocking_reason: Although AutoGen itself has canonical S2=A, this benchmark does not isolate an explicit native disturbance-to-attenuation outcome for that S2 path.

frameworks.runner_organization: benchmark creates a sequential CrewAI task pipeline with delegation disabled
frameworks.blocking_reason: Canonical CrewAI does not establish S2 at the reviewed boundary, so this row cannot form a two-canonical-S2 comparison cell with AutoGen.

frameworks.runner_organization: benchmark authors a linear StateGraph with one node per role and fixed linear edges
frameworks.blocking_reason: Canonical LangGraph does not establish S2 at the reviewed runtime boundary; the benchmark-authored linear graph is not LangGraph-owned S2.

non_claim: AgentFailDB is a useful matched multi-framework failure-analysis surface, but its conflicting-output signal does not satisfy the direct S2 disturbance-to-attenuation gate and its compared framework set contains only one canonical S2 system. It therefore does not create a direct S2 family, observation, matched canonical cell, or primary baseline.
